text: A video service that relies on outside AI models can switch the model doing the work, or lose all trace of a call that failed, without anyone outside the team noticing. On 11 September 2026, ShortsOS's media analysis got the same high-demand error on four separate live attempts while calling a model through a moving latest alias. The team then changed how those calls are made and what each one leaves on record.
